name: Western Kentucky University
academic_ranking: National University, ranked #363 (tie) by U.S. News & World Report (2025-2026). Total enrollment ~16,762 (fall 2024) with ~14,593 undergraduates; undergrad IPEDS size ~12,155 (College Scorecard). Home to the Mahurin Honors College (Kentucky's first honors college) and the Gatton Academy. Overall admission rate ~93.9% (College Scorecard), making it a broadly accessible institution.
financial_aid: College Scorecard (U.S. Dept. of Education): in-state tuition & fees ~$11,652/yr; out-of-state ~$27,000/yr. Average net price for a public-school student ~$10,990/yr. Athletic scholarships and need-/merit-based aid administered through WKU Financial Aid; softball scholarship counts not publicly itemized on the athletics site.
facilities_notes: Home venue is the WKU Softball Complex in Bowling Green, KY (referenced in official WKU softball roster/team content).
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in Conference USA. Historically competitive under head coach Amy Tudor, including a C-USA East Division title in 2019 (18-6 conference record per WKU athletics content).
notes: Staff directory (wkusports.com/sports/softball/coaches) checked 2026-07-30. Softball-specific coaching staff: Amy Tudor (Head Coach), Kayla Bixel (Associate Head Coach), Melissa Mayeux (Assistant Coach). Support staff also listed: Josh Vortherms (Assistant Athletic Trainer) and Parker Cheuvront (Assistant Director) - these are support/administrative roles rather than coaches. Tuition/aid figures from U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard API (school 157401). Roster size = 13 distinct player profiles on the published softball roster page (checked 2026-07-30); this appears to be a small/transitional published roster. Coaches shown here are only those with softball-specific coaching titles per the directive.
